org.name: SageBio
org.details: Open Science and Open Source. Creator of Synapse.org, NIH-listed generalist repository for biomedical data managing 2+PB data. Enabler of DREAM biomedical challenges

title: Is Google AI Pro Colab permitted for processing gated patient genomic data?

latest.raw:
Hello SageBio team,

I have been granted access to the MVA Hackathon dataset and would like to use Google Colab (Google AI Pro subscription) for Track 1.

I plan to use only the standard Python CPU runtime hosted by Google, without generative AI features, Google Drive mounting, or external LLM APIs.

The VCF would be downloaded directly into the temporary Colab runtime, processed there, and deleted afterward. No patient genomic data would be published or intentionally shared with other users.

I understand that Google Colab is a third-party cloud service, and that a Google AI Pro subscription does not necessarily provide an enterprise data-processing agreement.

Does this setup satisfy the Processor vs. Recipient requirements described in Discussion #2? If not, what additional safeguards or agreements would be required?

Thank you for your guidance.
